evidence.claim: The transaction model, trained on the bank's own closed cases from July to October (its July-September version scored AUC 0.972 on October), scores this transaction 0.012, against a 2.0% base rate. It reads the unnamed Vesta C/D/M/V columns, the identity record, running aggregates of the resolved account and the graph's memory of earlier closed cases, all as known at transaction time. January activity is newer than anything the model learned from and carries patterns it has never seen, so a low score counts at most as weak evidence of innocence: its weight is bounded to between 0.5 and 8
This card is used almost only in person (8 of 169 earlier transactions online); this purchase is online
Both card-present and online purchases on the same account within 48 hours, with identity anomalies (new device, proxy or name/address match flag)
$228.01 is in the top 3% of this card's purchase amounts

The alert's score (0.80, as in the case record) differs from the score stored on the transaction (0.10). Two bank sources disagree, and neither moves the decision: the bank warns its model is near useless for January, so its score is not used as evidence
Case memory: similar closed cases retrieved by graph-filtered vector search and account lineage: CC-0681 (cleared, none); CC-0281 (cleared, none); CC-3873 (cleared, none); CC-0831 (cleared, none)

case.summary: This case was opened because the system reported: "Real-time model scored transaction 3660355 ($228.01, online) at 0.8. Review and decide." for card C09177-K1. Graph evidence showed that while the transaction model scored the purchase very low at 0.012, the amount was in the top 3% of the card's history and occurred online for a card typically used in person. Additionally, there were both card-present and online purchases within 48 hours using a new device, prompting a customer validation request. The simulated reply indicated that the cardholder confirmed they made the purchase. Consequently, the final verdict is legitimate, and the final actions are ALLOW_TRANSACTION and CLOSE_NO_FRAUD.
